title: What stays unseen becomes fate
src: Jung, Aion (Collected Works 9, part II), paragraph 126
idea: Jung wrote that when an inner situation is not made conscious, it happens outside as fate. Patterns you do not see keep repeating.
apply: If the same problem keeps recurring, list what the situations have in common. Look for your part.
remind: Make it conscious, or it will keep happening to you.
who: Ivy, who keeps dating people who cancel plans.

scenes.nar: Ivy has dated three people in two years. All of them cancel plans, stay busy, and fade out.
She calls it bad luck. But luck does not usually repeat this exactly.

items.x: What did I ignore early on?
Which signs did I explain away?
What do I get from guarded people?

scenes.nar: Jung said what we do not make conscious shows up as fate. Ivy lists what the three had in common, and what signs she explained away early.

items.x: She is drawn to guarded people

scenes.nar: She sees she is drawn to guarded people, because they feel familiar. Once she sees it, she can choose differently, and the pattern breaks.
